headline: OpenAI releases formal proof system for Navier-Stokes problem
body: OpenAI has released a solution to the Navier-Stokes problem using Lean 4 formal proof technology, generating significant discussion across 20 unique authors on technical platforms. For healthcare AI, formal proof systems represent a critical advancement toward verifiable clinical decision support and algorithmic transparency required by regulators and clinicians. This capability directly addresses the validation gap in deployed healthcare AI models where formal verification of mathematical properties could strengthen FDA submissions and reduce liability exposure. Healthcare vendors and consultants should monitor whether formal proof methodologies become industry standard for high-stakes applications like diagnostic algorithms and treatment recommendations.
